usados.tema: Sea otters hold hands with each other while they sleep so they don't drift apart in the ocean currents.
usados.titulo: Why Sea Otters Hold Hands While Sleeping

usados.tema: Wombats are the only known animals in the world that produce cube-shaped feces, which prevents the droppings from rolling away.
Cows have best friends within their herds and become visibly stressed and anxious when they are separated from them.
usados.titulo: Cows Have Best Friends And Get Sad Without Them
